sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000140-P1, was presented by GSK PHARM (the Supplier) to Blue Ridge Medical Group 140 on May 14, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Hepatitis share floor of 85%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
